title: An Extension Study of KCT-0809 in Dry Eye Patients With Sjögren's Syndrome
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate of the long-term safety and efficacy of KCT-0809 in dry eye patients with Sjögren's syndrome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dry eye patients with Sjögren's syndrome finished KCT1301 study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with poor adherence to medication of study drug in KCT1301 study
